related_formalizations.note: Felix Weilacher PerfectSpace, Preperfect and accumulation-point definitions are reused; exact semantic expansions and equivalent punctured-neighborhood formulation are retained.

Sebastien Gouezel finite-prefix/cylinder and product-topology APIs reused. The new full covering binary scheme and basis-decision address map are local, not an invocation of an existing homeomorphism characterization.

Countable subfamily extraction and basis-neighborhood API reused, together with pinned compact nested-intersection and compact-to-Hausdorff inverse-continuity results. File-level attribution is retained in the definition inventory.

Clopen-cylinder, clopen-basis and homeomorphism-pullback proof code adapted with attribution. The earlier theorem concerns Baire space and infinite branching; it does not supply this Cantor homeomorphism.
